New Sidebar Styling

The sidebar now features expandable sections with VS Code dark theme colors:

Key Features:

  • Expandable/collapsible sections with animated chevron arrows
  • Category icons for visual hierarchy (tasks, briefcase, cog)
  • UPPERCASE section titles for clear organization
  • Bullet icons for list items
  • Hover states (#2A2D2E) and selection highlighting (#37373D)
  • VS Code color scheme throughout

Technical Implementation:

  • Reusable SidebarSection control component
  • Centralized styles in SidebarStyles.axaml
  • ~200 lines of XAML code eliminated
  • 70% average code reduction per view
  • Type-safe properties with IntelliSense support

Port Discovery Features:
